tasks.title: AI-tab panel buttons
steps: CRITICAL BOOTSTRAP: the af worktree has NO built UI (dist/ is gitignored). Before ANY runner or gate call, run: export EDITOR_UI_DIR=/home/weiss/git/World-Office/server/apps/web/apps/documenteditor-react/dist  (the prebuilt bundle lives in the main checkout). Without it the runner throws "no editor bundle". The gate af-gate.sh inherits this env, so export it once in your shell.
Edit ONLY tests/parity/word-parity-contracts.json. Do NOT run generate-manifest.cjs (it is regen-safe now but unnecessary). Do NOT edit overrides drop-ins or any other file.
Add a "contract" block ONLY to entries whose token is in the list below and that currently lack a "contract" key.

Verify EACH token individually or in small csv batches: node tests/parity/contract-runner.cjs --only <csv> --results /tmp/r9.json  (--only takes a separate arg). pkill -f contract-runner.cjs first if a stale runner lingers.
KEEP ONLY tokens that print PASS. For any FAIL token, REMOVE its contract block entirely — the gate requires fail==0, a committed FAIL contract fails the whole gate.
